params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Sortable columns are `severity`, `finding_type`, `finding`, `title`, `platform`, `environment_id`, `environment_name`,
`zone_id`, `zone_name`, `source_principal_id`, `source_principal_kind`, `source_principal_name`, `target_principal_id`, `target_principal_kind`, `target_principal_name`, `status`, `first_seen`, `last_seen`.

params.name: severity
params.description: Filter by severity level.

params.name: finding_type
params.description: Filter by finding type. When not provided, both types are returned.

params.name: finding
params.description: Filter by finding name.

params.name: title
params.description: Filter by human-readable finding title.

params.name: platform
params.description: Filter by platform.

params.name: environment_id
params.description: Filter by one or more environment identifiers. Repeat the parameter to include multiple environments — results are the union of all specified values.

params.name: environment_name
params.description: Filter by environment display name.

params.name: asset_group_tag_id
params.description:
Filter by one or more asset group tag identifiers. Repeat the parameter to include multiple asset group tags — results are the union of all specified values.
Cannot be combined with the `zone_id` filter.

params.name: zone_id
params.description: Filter by a single zone identifier. Cannot be combined with `asset_group_tag_id`.

params.name: zone_name
params.description: Filter by zone name (e.g. "Tier Zero").

params.name: source_principal_id
params.description: Filter by source principal identifier.

params.name: source_principal_kind
params.description: Filter by source principal kind.

params.name: source_principal_name
params.description: Filter by source principal display name.

params.name: target_principal_id
params.description: Filter by target principal identifier.

params.name: target_principal_kind
params.description: Filter by target principal kind.

params.name: target_principal_name
params.description: Filter by target principal display name.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by finding status.

params.name: first_seen
params.description: Filter by first seen timestamp.

params.name: last_seen
params.description: Filter by last seen timestamp.

params.name: skip
params.description: This query parameter is used for determining the number of objects to skip in pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: This query parameter is used for setting an upper limit of objects returned in paginated responses.

Lists detailed data about attack paths for a domain.

__Note:__ `ImpactCount`, `ImpactPercentage`, `ExposureCount`, `ExposurePercentage` and `Severity` will have a value other than zero when butterfly analysis is enabled.
